Trump's Manila Visit Includes Jollibee Meal and Meeting with Marcos Family

During a visit to Manila, US President Donald Trump was treated to a meal of Jollibee fried chicken by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Marcos Jr. mentioned to Trump that he had asked his mother, Imelda Marcos, to greet the US delegation, indicating a prior acquaintance between Trump and the former first lady. The event occurred on Wednesday at Malacanang Palace.
